name: Fantasy: Night Quilt Enchanted
tagline: The Night Quilt wanders into a fairy-tale realm: every enchanted object is a felt patch sewn onto the midnight quilt, and the Wolf waits behind a magic mirror.

fonts.display: Fraunces 800-900, SOFT 100 (titles in cream felt with a couched gold outline; WONK italics for the storybook voice: 'Mirror, mirror,', roles, ribbons)
fonts.body: Figtree 600-700 (answers on the mirror glass, body copy, names)
fonts.ui: Figtree 700-800 for buttons, chips and fields

motifs: The shared fairy-tale icon kit rebuilt as felt appliqué: fibre-textured, puffed felt with a gold blanket stitch traced around every silhouette (no sticker borders)
The 16 avatar tokens as embroidered badges: dark felt discs, merrowed gold satin rims, each icon outlined in gold satin stitch
Two identical magic mirrors: indigo velvet band between couched gold cords, French knots, scrollwork curls, slot letter on the crest
The countdown is a felt clock tower whose face is a gold seam unpicked one stitch per second toward midnight
A castle silhouetted against the appliquéd moon, villagers' patches hung on a gold-thread garland, and the Wolf's gold eyes watching from the quilted pines
reveal: Both answers sit in identical couched-gold mirror frames; at the reveal the Wolf's glass is torn open in silver darning and the felt Wolf pushes up through it with his ears over the frame while the quilting ripples out from him, and the true mirror warms to gold, reflects Maya's glass slipper inside a ring of gold-thread rays and takes the 'The real Maya' ribbon.
why: Midnight indigo with cream and gold thread keeps glare low in a dark room, while the pale mirror glass is the brightest, calmest spot on screen, so the two answers read from the back of the room. The fairy-tale objects arrive as stitched felt patches on the same quilt, so the realm grows richer without losing the quiet, grown-up Night Quilt the room already liked.
